title: Head of EdTech Platforms & Institutional Learning
description: Drive digital learning solutions, institutional academic administration, curriculum innovation, and scalable EdTech platform deployment.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead digital transformation in higher education and K-12 institutional learning platforms, instructional design, and student engagement tools.

### Key Responsibilities
- Oversee learning management system (LMS) adoption, digital curriculum design, and interactive assessment tools.
- Partner with university academic boards and institutional leaders to align learning outcomes.
- Manage EdTech engineering teams developing mobile learning applications and virtual classrooms.

### Requirements
- Master's in Education, Learning Design, or Computer Science.
- 5+ years of leadership in institutional education systems or EdTech platform development.
